acceptanceCriteria: When a customer purchases a return trip ticket with a promo code applied, the Mozio confirmation email displays the promo code discount amount for both the outbound trip and the return trip.

When the Mozio confirmation email is generated for an order containing a return trip, the return trip line item shows the same promo code discount amount format and placement as the outbound trip line item.
When a customer purchases a one-way trip ticket with a promo code applied, the Mozio confirmation email displays the promo code discount amount for that single trip without regression.
When an order contains multiple return trip line items (e.g., multiple passengers), the Mozio confirmation email displays the promo code discount amount for the return portion of each line item.

When a return trip order with a promo code has a promo discount of zero or the promo code is invalid, the Mozio confirmation email does not display a promo code discount amount for either the outbound or return trip.

When the Mozio confirmation email is rendered, the promo code discount amount for the return trip is calculated using the same discount logic and value as the outbound trip, assuming the promo applies to the full booking.
